title: MTF 对齐 reindex+ffill 缺 shift(1)，潜在 0.20 ROC-AUC look-ahead 虚高
description: mtf_aligner.py:177 用 df.reindex(aligned_index).ffill() 实现高时间框架下采样，注释自称「ffill 确保无未来数据泄漏」，但 ffill ≠ shift(1)。若高时间框架 bar 以 bar-open 时间戳索引，reindex+ffill 会让该 bar 的值在 bar 开始即对低时间框架可见，而非 bar 收盘后。MDPI Risks 8(3)40 论文指出此偏差使 ROC-AUC 虚高约 0.20（0.60→0.80），且据作者所知文献中未被显式讨论。应先核实 fetcher OHLCV 时间戳语义（bar-open vs bar-close），若为 bar-open 则需在 as-of merge 前对高时间框架时间戳 shift(1)。
fix_direction: mtf_aligner.py:177 — 先读 data 层 fetcher 确认时间戳语义；若 bar-open，reindex+ffill 前加 .shift(1) 或用 searchsorted(side='right') as-of merge

context.suggested_fix: 核实 fetcher 时间戳语义后，对高时间框架时间戳前移一个周期再 as-of merge
context.notes: 来源: deep-research-20260718 F1 (3-0 verified), MDPI Risks 8(3)40。未验证项: fetcher 时间戳语义决定偏差严重程度

title: 增量策略逻辑可能与向量化研究逻辑漂移
description: 为 on_bar 添加增量路径后，增量指标计算可能与向量化 generate_signals 结果不一致。若无 parity 测试保障，策略在回测和实盘中表现会差异。
fix_direction: 每个策略添加 golden parity fixture，比较增量 vs 向量化信号输出

context.suggested_fix: Add deterministic parity tests per strategy
context.notes: 来源: ANL-001 residual_risks + context.md locked constraint

issue_history.note: P1-verify parity guard landed (tests/unit/test_strategies.py::TestSignalParityGuard). Per-bar incremental (_latest_signal) vs vectorized (generate_signals) across 5 seeds (42/7/123/2024/99): ENTRY signal 0 drift (5/5 seeds green) — P1-verify F3 foundation solid. EXIT signal systematic drift (12..22 of 122 bars/seed) — root cause located: _latest_signal exit uses (trend_down + rsi_ok_short + atr_ok) without vol_ok, threshold max(min_conditions-1,2); generate_signals exits uses (trend_down + rsi_ok_short + vol_ok + atr_ok) threshold min_conditions, then OR profit_exits|trailing_exits. Two exit-path semantics diverge by design (comment '# exit without vol_ok'). Exit drift recorded as known item in test_exit_signal_drift_is_known_and_bounded (band 1..30), NOT fixed in P1-verify (out of scope, would perturb P1 byte-for-byte regression guard). Awaits ISS-006 semantic decision: unify exit to one semantics, then upgrade guard to strict parity.

EXIT drift ROOT CAUSE FIXED (commit pending): generate_signals exit now mirrors _latest_signal — exit_count = trend_down + rsi_ok_short + atr_ok (NO vol_ok), threshold max(min_conditions-1, 2). Previously used short_count (with vol_ok, threshold min_conditions), violating the documented '# exit without vol_ok' design intent. Parity guard test_exit_residual_is_profit_trailing_role_difference confirms: condition-exit drift eliminated; residual 1..16/122 is a ROLE difference (generate_signals.exits = condition|profit|trailing vs _latest_signal = condition-only; profit/trailing handled by on_bar's _check_position_exits), all one-sided (inc=False,vec=True) shape. 1428 tests pass, zero regression. DEEPER gap found (registered as parity-guard-pending, NOT a fix in this scope): on_bar applies regime gating (engine skips strategy.on_bar when required_regime != detected regime via ADX>=25), but generate_signals does NOT. On real BTC/USDT 1h, ALL 84 generate_signals entries fall on non-trending bars → on_bar gates them all → backtest trades 84x, live trades 0x. Root: trend_following entry uses MA direction (fast>slow & MACD>0), regime uses ADX strength — direction != strength. Guard TestRegimeParityGap quantifies the gap. Design conflict, not a bug — regime gating is execution-layer; mixing into generate_signals breaks its stateless research-API contract. Awaits human decision on regime-vs-entry alignment.
Closed via manage-issue: exit drift root cause fixed (0dbee17); regime gap -> ISS-20260720-001

resolution: 已修复 exit 漂移根因（commit 0dbee17）：generate_signals exit 此前用 short_count（含 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions），与 _latest_signal 的 exit_count（无 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions-1）不一致，违反 '# exit without vol_ok' 设计意图。对齐为无 vol_ok + 阈值 min_conditions-1。parity 守卫 test_exit_residual_is_profit_trailing_role_difference 确认条件 exit 漂移消除（12..22→1..16），残留单向 shape = profit/trailing 合并职责差异非 bug。注：regime 维度更深 parity 缺口（on_bar 应用 ADX regime gating 而 generate_signals 不应用）另建 ISS-20260720-001 跟踪，不属本 issue exit 范畴。本 issue 原始诉求（增量 vs 向量化信号漂移）的 exit 部分已闭环。
